source.prompt: Deep house song, about 3.5 minutes, 118 BPM, F minor. After-hours harbour mood, smoky, warm and intimate. Soft, breathy female lead vocal with gentle stacked harmonies on the chorus. Rhodes electric piano chords, warm upright-style finger bass, clean muted electric guitar licks, soft string pad. Four-on-the-floor kick, offbeat open hats, rimshot and claps on 2 and 4, light shaker. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Intro]
Mm, mm

[Verse]
Streetlights hum a quiet tune
Half past two and half a moon
You and I on the harbour wall
Waiting for the dark to fall

[Pre-Chorus]
Slow down, slow down, don't say a word
Let the city be the only thing we heard

[Chorus]
Meet me where the night folds
Soft as a secret, warm as gold
Hold me where the night folds
Under the stars we never told

[Verse]
Paper boats on silver streams
Little lights like borrowed dreams
Every heartbeat, every sigh
Drifting with the tide tonight

[Pre-Chorus]
Slow down, slow down, don't say a word
Let the city be the only thing we heard

[Chorus]
Meet me where the night folds
Soft as a secret, warm as gold
Hold me where the night folds
Under the stars we never told

[Bridge]
Fold me in, fold me in
Till the morning comes again

[Chorus]
Meet me where the night folds
Soft as a secret, warm as gold
Hold me where the night folds
Under the stars we never told
